name: Mailjet Webform Subscription
description: adds a custom Webform checkbox element that subscribes a submitter's email to a Mailjet contact list, with a double-opt-in confirmation link.
project_description:
The Mailjet Webform Subscription module provides seamless integration between Drupal's Webform module and Mailjet, allowing website owners to easily subscribe users to a Mailjet contact list via a simple checkbox element. It ensures an efficient subscription process with optional confirmation e-mails powered by Mailjet templates.

 
 Main features/ functionalities: 
 Easy Mailjet integration: 

 
 Add a Mailjet subscription checkbox to any webform. 
 Automatically add users to a Mailjet contact list. 
 
 Subscription confirmation: 

 
 Optional user confirmation (double opt-in) before subscribing. 
 Optional success confirmation for newly subscribed users. 
 Customizable confirmation e-mails via Mailjet templates.
 
 
 
 
 Requirements/ dependencies: 
 
 Webform 
 Mailjet 
 
 
 
 Installation: 
 
 Set MailJet API keys at admin/config/system/mailjet/api.
 Add component type 'Mailjet Subscription' to your webform. 
 On component settings page, select your contact list. 
 Add component type 'E-mail' to your webform (the value of that field will be used as subscriber e-mail).
